armyRules.name: Ferrea Mole, Ferreo Cuore (Iron Hulls, Iron Hearts)
armyRules.text: Any Italian vehicle with this special rule in its entry may re-roll failed Advance and Run order tests. This rule does not apply when coming onto the table from reserve or outflanking, and it also does not apply for assaults.

armyRules.name: Alzo Zero! (Open Sights!)
armyRules.text: All Italian artillery units may reroll any failed morale checks.

armyRules.name: Mixed Quality
armyRules.text: All Inexperienced Italian infantry units have the Green special rule.

armyRules.name: Defensive Strategy
armyRules.text: During the first turn of the game, the enemy cannot order their units on the table to Run as they cautiously probe the terrain in front of the Italian line for minefields and make their way across barbed wire. Enemy units in first wave are exempt and can be ordered to Run as normal to enter the table. Any of your Regular or Veteran unit that is set up on the table before Turn 1 may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them as you deploy them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush, before drawing the first order die on Turn 1. In scenarios that require an attacker and a defender the Italian player may choose if they want to be defender or not, except if both forces are Italian, in which case this rule has no effect.

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Jettison fuel trailer
rules.text: The normal bonus for trying to damage flamethrowing vehicles does not apply.

rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Jettison fuel trailer
rules.text: The normal bonus for trying to damage flamethrowing vehicles does not apply.

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: HE (1")
rules.text: PEN: +1, PIN: D2 (D3 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken (rounded up).

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

armyRules.name: Ferrea Mole, Ferreo Cuore (Iron Hulls, Iron Hearts)
armyRules.text: Any Italian vehicle with this special rule in its entry may re-roll failed Advance and Run order tests. This rule does not apply when coming onto the table from reserve or outflanking, and it also does not apply for assaults.

armyRules.name: Alzo Zero! (Open Sights!)
armyRules.text: All Italian artillery units may reroll any failed morale checks.

armyRules.name: Mixed Quality
armyRules.text: All Inexperienced Italian infantry units have the Green special rule.

armyRules.name: Defensive Strategy
armyRules.text: During the first turn of the game, the enemy cannot order their units on the table to Run as they cautiously probe the terrain in front of the Italian line for minefields and make their way across barbed wire. Enemy units in first wave are exempt and can be ordered to Run as normal to enter the table. Any of your Regular or Veteran unit that is set up on the table before Turn 1 may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them as you deploy them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush, before drawing the first order die on Turn 1. In scenarios that require an attacker and a defender the Italian player may choose if they want to be defender or not, except if both forces are Italian, in which case this rule has no effect.
